AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Milk souring
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.

5. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.

11. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

15. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Producers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Tertiary consumers

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Growing Fruits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Uses of Domestic Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
